verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration service, so dependent visas are a fair question to ask of it. But nothing in the evidence pack mentions O-3, H-4, dependent petitions, spouses, children, or dependent work authorization. The general claim of a 'suite of visas and green card pathways' does not document dependent coverage.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service
